14.name: Flap with Button
14.description: A sportier take on the rear pocket, providing a more relaxed appeal.

15.name: Jetted with Button
15.description: A timeless trouser feature granting a classic, tailored look.

16.name: Jetted No Button
16.description: The jetted rear pocket, crafted without buttons, offers a sleek, elegant look ideal for black-tie styles.

114.name: Belt Loops
114.description: Classic yet versatile, finished for wearing with or without a belt

115.name: Single Closure Buckle
115.description: Single Closure Buckle as found on our Fellini trouser

116.name: Double Closure Buckle
116.description: Double Closure Buckle as found on our Gurkha trouser

118.name: Long Side Adjusters
118.description: This variant features buckles on either hip on the waistband, but with extended fabric at the back end for a small style detail.

119.name: None
119.description: No side adjusters or belt loops for a clean, minimalist finish

121.name: Winged Side Adjusters
121.description: This "winged" variant features buckles on either hip on the waistband, but with extended, pointed, fabric at the back end for a small style detail.

166.name: Flap Coin Pocket
166.description: An external coin pocket with a buttonable flap closure.

168.name: Hidden Coin Pocket
168.description: A small coin pocket hidden from view

206.name: Extended Peak Slim
206.description: This sartorial waistband features a slim peak closure with two belt loops and exposed button. Found on our Blake trouser

207.name: Extended Peak
207.description: A bold sartorial closure with a extended peak and a single exposed button. Found on our Braddon trouser

208.name: Extended Straight
208.description: A sleek, waistband with a hidden button and single belt loop for securing the extended closure. Found on our Brentwood trouser

209.name: Standard button
209.description: A classic, straightforward waistband with an exposed button.

210.name: Single Side closure
210.description: A clean, featureless front, using instead a buckle closure on the right hip of the waistband. Found on our Fellini trouser

211.name: Double Side closure
211.description: This military-inspired style features a distinct adjustable buckles on both hips and a full extension across the front.

212.name: Standard Hidden button
212.description: Our classic waistband with a single hidden button under a squared shaped closure.

387.name: Full
387.description: Fully lined trouser legs feature a soft layer of interior lining, giving the pair a more structured look.

388.name: Half
388.description: Half-lined trousers feature lining throughout the top half for a more structured fit around the thighs.

389.name: Unlined
389.description: Lightweight and more breathable unlined trousers are the best pick for a more casual appeal.

706.name: Plain
706.description: Hemmed trousers feature the bottom fabric folded up inside the pant leg for a clean finish.

707.name: Turn Up 4 cm
707.description: 4cm cuffs show more of the sock, grants the illusion of height and adds weight for a nicer drape.

708.name: Turn Up 5 cm
708.description: Bold 5cm cuffs show even more sock or ankle, grants the illusion of height & adds weight for a nicer drape.

709.name: Unfinished
709.description: Unfinished hems offer 11 extra centimeters of fabric, allowing you to finish the trousers your way.

828.name: Jetted
828.description: Formal & exclusively aesthetic, jetted pockets are defined by a fine trimmed slit cut into the fabric.

829.name: Seam
829.description: The pocket is built into the side seams. They provide a clean, streamlined silhouette.

830.name: Slanted
830.description: The most common style, slanted pockets are versatile enough for casual and more formal occasions.

839.name: No
839.description: This style is crafted with no interior suspender buttons.

840.name: Yes
840.description: Made to be worn with suspenders, trousers with interior buttons allow for hidden fastening.

874.name: Standard Double Pleat
874.description: Double standard pleats opens towards the side seam.

875.name: None
875.description: Non-pleated trousers, known as flat fronted, lie flat against the leg for a neat, versatile appeal.

876.name: Inward Double Pleat
876.description: Double inward pleats opens towards the crotch.

877.name: Inward Single Pleat
877.description: A single inward pleat opens towards the crotch.

878.name: Standard Single Pleat
878.description: The standard single pleat opens towards the side seam.

935.name: Enlarged
935.description: This feature extends the crotch finish with a subtly tilted front and extra width to provide a roomier fit.

styles.name: Slim Leg Single Pleat
styles.description: This style features an expended peak closure, pleated front, side adjusters & a turn up.

styles.name: Slim Leg Flat Front
styles.description: This style features a hidden button closure, flat front & belt loops.
